Dear Ying Xuan

Greetings. This is Ms Loh who is the SLS account administrator.
To facilitate your learning in SST, you need to have an active SLS account.

According to records in SLS, your account has been locked.

I’ve unlocked and reset the password for your SLS account:

*SLSSOSATS7805*


Use the USER ID as shown in the image.

Remember to update your email address to SST email address.


Let me know if you have successfully login to the system.


[image: Screenshot [phone_17377296] at 14.45.53.png]


*With regards*
